modules.title: Getting Started
modules.description: New here? Start with these. They set up your computer and teach the basics.

modules.title: HTML Foundations
modules.description: Learn HTML one piece at a time, with real websites to explore. Do them in order.

modules.title: CSS: Basics
modules.description: The foundations of CSS: what it is, syntax, how to add it, selectors, colours and backgrounds.

modules.title: CSS: Box Model & Text
modules.description: Space and style content: the box model, padding and margin, borders, sizing, text and fonts.

modules.title: CSS: Layout
modules.description: Arrange the page: display types, positioning, float, overflow and z-index, and building a nav bar.

modules.title: CSS: Flexbox & Grid
modules.description: Modern layout: Flexbox for rows, Grid for two-dimensional layouts, and a responsive card gallery project.

modules.title: CSS: Advanced
modules.description: Polish and motion: pseudo-classes/elements, variables, gradients, shadows, transitions and animations.

modules.title: CSS: Responsive
modules.description: Make it work on every screen: units, media queries, responsive design, specificity, and a full styling project.

modules.title: JavaScript: Basics
modules.description: Run real code with Node in the terminal: setup, syntax, variables, data types, operators, type conversion, and your first functions.

modules.title: JavaScript: Control Flow
modules.description: Make decisions and repeat work: if/else, switch, for and while loops, and looping over items.

modules.title: JavaScript: Data & Structures
modules.description: Work with real data: strings, numbers, the Math toolbox, dates, arrays and their methods, plus Sets and Maps.

modules.title: JavaScript: Scope, Objects & Classes
modules.description: Organise your code: scope, arrow functions, objects, classes and JSON.

modules.title: JavaScript: DOM & Events
modules.description: Bring pages to life: select and change elements, react to clicks and input, handle forms, and use timers.

modules.title: JavaScript: Advanced
modules.description: Level up: errors and try/catch, debugging, regular expressions, async/await, fetching live data, and modules.

modules.title: Build Your Portfolio
modules.description: The final project: combine HTML, CSS and JavaScript into a personal portfolio. Graded by your teacher.
